name: Zed Free Code Editor
free_limit: Free desktop code editor for macOS, Linux and Windows without sign-in or subscription; limited Edit Predictions and support for external AI agents or your own model API keys.
watch_out: The free editor does not include Zed-hosted AI models. Zed Pro's 14-day trial and its hosted-model token credits are separate, time-limited or paid benefits; own-provider API usage may cost money. Editor source is primarily GPL-3.0-or-later (server components have separate terms); comply with copyleft obligations when redistributing modified software.
